basin.criterion: S9 capture criterion reused verbatim (>=2 distinct finite inits converge to same nonsaturated active regime)

communication.criterion: cut-controlled downstream transmission nonzero across efficacy/duration/convergence axes (S7 propagation battery reused)

operation.current_balance: pathway/class realized currents recorded (no target; evidence for V2.2)
operation.drive: tonic-only, per-class uniform, values predeclared at execution
operation.gate: finite nonsaturated irregular E/PV/SST/VIP cortical operation
operation.heterogeneity: across-neuron rate CV >= 0.3 within E (excludes locked-step)
operation.irregularity: per-neuron ISI CV in [0.5, 1.5] for >=80% of active cells (excludes clock-sync and Poisson-burst)
operation.synchrony: S9 guard reused: steps with >50% E co-spiking < 0.01

recurrence.criterion: REC ON vs matched REC OFF (same drive): E response gain >= 1.2 AND recurrent current fraction >= 0.2 (thresholds frozen at V2.2 execution authorization)

candidate_family.architecture: single C-min-architecture column (cells, laminar motifs, convergence unchanged: never the falsified variable)
candidate_family.cells: standard cortical Izhikevich classes as built (RS E, FS PV, LTS SST, VIP); intrinsic params frozen pending D3/D4 excitability review
candidate_family.drive: tonic-only (no schedule), per-class uniform; values predeclared at V2.1 execution authorization
candidate_family.efficacy: STATIC efficacies at measured s=1 magnitudes (HDP dynamics detached for V2.1/V2.2 to isolate operation; HDP re-enters only after the basin gate)
candidate_family.note: minimum departure from the qualified line: same engine, same column, same cells; only the operating regime (gain scale + tonic support + static-first) changes

defect_mapping.defect: Uniform E-drive jumps silence->5000 Hz global sync 2-cycle with no settled intermediate (S9 prep scans; B bisection/flip intervals; N1 sustained-sync transients)
defect_mapping.min_dof: E-out efficacy operating range (order-unity, near the qualified s=1 shape regime) + tonic drive level as explicit regime variable
defect_mapping.requirement: First operate at E-efficacy scale where onset volleys do not avalanche; tonic-supported asynchronous regime before any zero-tonic target

defect_mapping.defect: Silence strongly absorbing at zero tonic: rest and HDP-primed rest collapse exactly (S9 P0/P7 all candidates)
defect_mapping.min_dof: tonic amplitude as regime variable (predeclared per gate, shared across candidates)
defect_mapping.requirement: No zero-tonic persistence target before driven irregular operation passes; drive regime is support, not tuning

defect_mapping.defect: Single-cell F-I jump 0->7 Hz with no graded 1-4 Hz regime (Phase-2 below-band substitution, driver rule-independent)
defect_mapping.min_dof: baseline excitability within standard cortical families (offsets/gains; class-specific only where measured, e.g. VIP)
defect_mapping.requirement: Graded low-rate class responses under generic drive

defect_mapping.defect: VIP silent: rheobase 24 vs E/PV 4, SST 2; never recruited in any battery or release
defect_mapping.min_dof: VIP excitability offset within the D3 excitability review
defect_mapping.requirement: VIP viable (active) under the generic drive regime at V2.1

defect_mapping.defect: S7/S8 coarse fixed point off the native manifold (B verdict); 235/235 near-identical coarse states with divergent futures (N3)
defect_mapping.requirement: No fixed-point-first design; gates ordered operation->recurrence->basin with native execution evidence at each step

defect_mapping.defect: Strong fast-loop gain rho~2.5-4.2 with thin slaving margin at 50x (S8 caveats)
defect_mapping.requirement: Operate where recurrent gain is moderate; re-check slaving margins under V2 plants

drift_guards: G1 gate ordering: no persistence/basin execution before V2.1+V2.2 PASS are sealed
G2 one principal delta per lineage edge (repository convention)
G3 brackets predeclared from requirement ranges before execution; misses terminate FAIL, never silent retuning (retune = new lineage + new pre-registration)
G4 FAIL at any gate stops the line; new hypothesis = new branch + spec delta, never in-place parameter drift
G5 tonic is a regime variable, not a tuning knob: values predeclared per gate and shared across candidates within a gate
next_authorized_action: specification review; V2.1 execution requires explicit authorization
reopened_variables: neuron operating regime (Izhikevich class parameters within cortical families)
circuit balance (E/I convergence and efficacy operating ranges)
architecture sufficient for ordinary cortical dynamics (laminar motifs, delays)
status: SPECIFICATION (design-only; no simulation executed or authorized)
what_must_remain_fixed: canonical drive semantics (tonic/schedule distinction, pure-pulse assay)
native HDP rule infrastructure (registrable rules, edge-local state)
omission firewall (no omission tuning before freeze)
all recurrent and propagation falsifications (they become requirements, not history)
